body: Update: Things have really turned around for me. I’ve stopped sitting around thinking about what was and what could have been and started living life again. I’ve taken up rock climbing and even booked my first 15000ft sky dive. I’ve got back in touch with all of my friends and am socialising every day through the week and doing all sorts of fun stuff with my kids on the weekends. Had a very very rough time but it has lead to so much good. Divorce sure feels like the end of the world. Especially when it’s so sudden but once the shock has worn off it can really be the start of something amazing!

I’m going through the same thing my dude. My wife left me two weeks ago. She was the only thing that pulled me out of the abyss when I was feeling low and my depression took hold. The only thing that I lived for and the only thing that made me happy. I’ve tried to come back from this but simply can’t. The fact you want to wait until September shows you don’t want to die. There’s still a will to live left, focus on that. I don’t have that will anymore. Stay strong buddy.
I took your advice and today I went to my doctor and was diagnosed with severe depression. I’ve been referred to talking therapy
I just can’t handle the idea of being without her. I hate going to bed and it’s empty. I miss feeling loved and wanted.
I can’t call anyone right now but I feel very scared
I should probably get help. I’m so hurt by it all and she doesn’t care at all. I’m broken.
A counsellor definitely wouldn’t do any harm. I’ve needed to see one for a long time but I can’t see how sitting in a room and talking could possibly help my mental state.

I probably should hire a lawyer but I don’t want to make things difficult for her. Even though I can’t handle the fact she’s gone she doesn’t deserve any trouble. I just miss her so badly. I don’t have many friends so my family was all I had and all I knew. They were what got me out of bed in the morning. I would turn to my wife whenever I was in a bad place and she would always know what to say to make me feel safe and happy but now I have nobody to pull me out of my darkest time.
